$description: NEXUS's own tokens over IBM Carbon and the CORTHEX layer. Only what the mockup uses and the base lacks; a token here would replace a Carbon or CORTHEX token of the same name.

shell.$description: The header above every screen. Like Carbon's UI shell, it stays Gray 100 in the light and the dark theme, as in the click mockup of 2026-11-21, so these values are the same in every mode.

background-hover.$description: A header button under the pointer.

text-secondary.$description: The project's name in the project menu.

focus.$description: The focus ring of a header button.
